mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a comfortable 68 degrees at the Verona Area High School, with a lovely waxing crescent moon overhead.
The Verona Senior Center is looking for volunteers who can commit to two shifts a month to support local services, and please note that road work on Highway M is scheduled to begin on August 18.
Today, you can check out the User Group Meeting at Epic or grab a session at Insight Wellness, while tomorrow features Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee trivia nights.
A notable incident from August 8 involved a vehicle rollover where the driver fled the scene, but Verona police successfully located and detained the individual for an O W I arrest.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so you have plenty of time to plan your visit.
